method: Actual preflight-before-copy: read review-protocol.md and action-first.json only, actually viewed both invitation720 images, manually recorded the four action fields, saved portfolio-action-first.json and successfully read it back before opening packet.json. After that, all four images were actually viewed through view_image in native, usage720 and thumbnail320 views. All 42 copy items below are manual visual transcriptions; no OCR was used. Equal means visible wording/punctuation match after layout line-wrap normalization, not a claim about hidden Unicode code points. Initial preflight record remains unchanged.
score_interpretation: All seven image scores use the unchanged protocol anchors. Set diversity and closest_pair.score both use the diversity anchor: 1 = repetition, 3 = distinguishable with structural habits remaining, 5 = convincingly different content/type/space/image directions. No aggregate score or winner is inferred.
scope_limits: Visible-output review only. Actual capacity, fold mechanics, repair mechanics, maker identity and print suitability cannot be certified from these pixels.

uncertainties: Visual raster review cannot certify the underlying Unicode identity of similar dash glyphs; visible range punctuation matches the supplied typography.
Actual 350 mL capacity, successful folding and physical lid fit are not measured or certified from an image.

preflight_action_fields.uncertainty: No uncertain visible character in these four fields; protocol is not displayed in URL.

evidence.content_form: The central eyeglass hinge with a screwdriver entering diagonally shows the small, non-electrical repair activity implied by the invitation. The title sits in the quiet upper photographic area, and the plain lower pane carries the actual attendance and handling conditions.
evidence.hierarchy: At 320 the large event title and repair photo lead, with the red bottom deadline/address standing apart; at 720 the bold date/time/location lead into the smaller terms and fee. All action-first fields were correctly found during preflight, though the long conditions block is denser than the prominent event and application groups.
evidence.typography: The black title and subtitle form a stable two-line group over the pale photograph; bold date and location structure the lower pane, while red singles out application. The six consecutive smaller terms are legible at 720, including the long completion disclaimer, but could be grouped more clearly by purpose.
evidence.space: The photo crop places the lens at left, hinge near center and driver/arm diagonals toward the right edge, leaving a clean top area for type. The lower pane has a consistent left margin and uncut URL with a right margin; consecutive terms have less breathing space than the headline/date/action groups.
evidence.image_material: At native size metal hinge scratches and highlights, dark tortoiseshell frame reflections, clear lens and fine pale work surface remain materially distinct. The driver tip and hinge meet without a conspicuous melted edge, and the light/shadow system reads coherently. This does not certify actual repair mechanics.
evidence.emotion_control: A recognizable everyday repair photograph, forceful plain black title and one red application line express practical help. The material detail carries interest without decorative effects, and the only strong color has a direct participation role.
evidence.ai_slop: The hinge-specific photograph and complete operational copy are content-related; native lettering, metal boundaries and lens reflections show no conspicuous synthetic failure. No fake logos or filler text appear. The remaining editorial limitation is the compressed sequence of terms in the lower pane, which is functional but less carefully differentiated than the leading groups.

residuals: The six consecutive condition lines in the lower pane have nearly uniform spacing → handling, repair limits and consent read as one dense block → introduce modest group spacing by purpose while retaining all six sentences and the full red application line.

closest_pair.evidence: The only pair differs meaningfully between pale studio two-state demonstration and dark handheld tote context. Both retain photographs of the same green/white object, upper-left sans text and lower-left launch-information stacks; a shared structural habit remains.

product.evidence: Exactly two independent 4:5 posters. Q513 makes expanded/folded states the focal relation and leads with brand/model; Q552 makes a portable folded cup in a hand the focal relation and leads with the Korean benefit. Different light, scale, crop, prop role and first-read emphasis are more than a filter change, while the common left-stacked type and photographic product grammar limit full distributional diversity.
residuals: Both images place launch/order/URL information as a lower-left stack; future differentiation could change that spatial relation while preserving the required content.

closest_pair.evidence: The only pair differs between a vertical macro repair photograph with bottom red action line and a square thin-line diagram with top blue action block and two-column information. Shared pale ground and heavy black event type provide some overlap, but the information priority and image roles are substantively different.

invitation.evidence: Exactly one 3:4 and one 1:1 invitation. Q959 leads with event/photo/date in a vertical sequence; Q405 leads with application and then separates logistics from handling conditions in columns. Photo versus diagram, action placement, crop and page structure differ convincingly. Both keep black bold event text and quiet pale backgrounds, so the set is not maximally separated in typographic/material vocabulary.
residuals: Q405 has a tight URL-to-mirror clearance and Q959 has a compressed condition block; the set-level distinction does not erase these individual residuals.
